name: Discrete Diode — 30V — 0603
description: Cluster of 30V SMD discrete diodes in the 0603 package family from Alternate-KiCad-Library, including Zener and Schottky parts.
selection_hints: Requires a 30V surface-mount (SMD) discrete diode in an 0603 package family.
Select between Zener (CDZ55C30T) and Schottky (BAT30F4) diode options.
Match layout requirements to footprints D_0603_1608Metric or D_0201_0603Metric.
avoid_when: The circuit requires a voltage rating other than 30V.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
The PCB layout requires package footprints outside the 0603 family.
